description: Two independent full-stack implementation assignments and two maintenance assignments, frozen after Parley v0.5.1 and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers.

tasks.title: Build a festival power planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Festival Power contract in the supplied stack. speaker_watts is speaker_towers * watts_each. lighting_watts is light_rigs * 900. weather_watts is (speaker_towers + light_rigs) * 75 when weather_cover is true and zero otherwise. total_watts is the sum of speaker, lighting, and weather watts. connection_points is speaker_towers * 3 + light_rigs * 5. power_score is total_watts + connection_points * 20. power_mode is mixed when both speakers and lights are present, lighting when only lights are present, and audio otherwise. The browser export returns power_score.
tasks.independence: New event-power domain, v3 route, load composition, field vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the v0.5.1 product checkpoint and before any 039 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build a clinic queue pressure service across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Clinic Queue contract in the supplied stack. patient_total is scheduled_count + walk_in_count. urgent_slots is clinician_count * 2 when urgent_open is true and zero otherwise. service_slots is clinician_count * 8 + urgent_slots. overflow_count is max(patient_total - service_slots, 0). waiting_groups divides overflow_count into five-patient groups using ceiling division, with zero overflow producing zero groups. queue_pressure is overflow_count * 4 + waiting_groups * 3. queue_state is clear when overflow_count is zero, urgent when overflow remains and urgent_open is true, and delayed otherwise. The browser export returns queue_pressure.
tasks.independence: New healthcare-queue domain, v3 route, capacity and pressure formula, field vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected before any 039 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair prepaid event credit after weekend fees
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Event Credit application. full_price_charge_cents is full_price_guests * 1800. concession_charge_cents is concession_guests * 950. weekend_fee_cents is (full_price_guests + concession_guests) * 175 during a weekend_event and zero otherwise. gross_charge_cents is the sum of full-price, concession, and weekend charges. credit_used_cents is min(prepaid_credit_cents, gross_charge_cents). amount_due_cents is max(gross_charge_cents - prepaid_credit_cents, 0). payment_state is covered when amount_due_cents is zero and due otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns amount_due_cents.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module caps prepaid credit against the adult-plus-youth base before adding the weekend fee, so credit cannot cover that fee.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair chilled-capacity propagation in seedling dispatch
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Seedling Dispatch application. shippable_trays is max(tray_count - reserved_trays, 0). base_capacity is van_count * 24. chill_buffer is van_count * 3 during chilled_transport and zero otherwise. dispatch_capacity is max(base_capacity - chill_buffer, 0). overflow_trays is max(shippable_trays - dispatch_capacity, 0). loaded_trays is min(shippable_trays, dispatch_capacity). space_remaining is max(dispatch_capacity - loaded_trays, 0). dispatch_state is overflow when overflow_trays is positive, loaded when loaded_trays is positive, and idle otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns overflow_trays.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module reports load, overflow, and remaining space from base_capacity instead of the reduced chilled dispatch_capacity.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.
